tools.name: index
tools.description: Index files or directories so search, symbols and get_context can use them. Re-run on files you changed.

tools.name: remove
tools.description: Remove a document and its chunks, symbols and annotations from the index.

tools.name: detect_changes
tools.description: Files modified, new or removed since the last index; changed files are re-indexed.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Ranked search over indexed chunks (BM25; hybrid with Tier-2 summaries). Previews by default; compact=false for full text.

tools.name: agent_grep
tools.description: Grep indexed files with enclosing scope and classification, within max_tokens (default 1000).

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Exact substring or regex over every indexed chunk, with perfect recall. limit defaults to 20.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Start here for a question: merges ranked search, symbol lookups and grep in one list.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Definitions and every usage of a symbol, with a verdict (referenced, unreferenced, external).

tools.name: find_definition
tools.description: Where a symbol is defined: path, line, signature and a short preview. full=true adds the chunk text.

tools.name: impact_radius
tools.description: What depends on a symbol, file or chunk, through the symbol graph.

tools.name: coupling
tools.description: Files coupled to a file through shared symbols.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Cached text of files with unchanged/changed/new status, so unchanged files need no re-read.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Session start: index health, counts, Tier-2 coverage and next steps.

tools.name: map
tools.description: Project overview: documents by token size (max_documents, default 50), totals, index health.

tools.name: document_lock
tools.description: Claim a file for one agent: acquire, refresh, release, release_all, status, conflicts, reap.

tools.name: annotations
tools.description: Notes on files or chunks that persist across sessions and agents: create, get, update, delete, search.

tools.name: register_dynamic_symbols
tools.description: Register runtime symbols (hooks, handlers) that have no definition in the source.

tools.name: remove_dynamic_symbols
tools.description: Remove the runtime symbols an agent registered.

tools.name: llm_embed
tools.description: Store your own text as a searchable memory chunk under chunk_id.

tools.name: bulk_store_summaries
tools.description: Store one-line summaries for chunks (Tier 2); they improve hybrid search.

tools.name: enrichment_plan
tools.description: Chunks worth summarizing next: the largest ones without a Tier-2 summary.

tools.name: get_search_history
tools.description: Searches already run in a session and the files they hit.

tools.name: get_session_read_files
tools.description: Files already read with get_context in a session.

tools.name: detect_modality
tools.description: File type of a path: code, text, pdf, image, audio or video.

tools.name: get_supported_formats
tools.description: Supported file extensions by modality.

tools.name: prune_history
tools.description: Delete old change-history entries by age or count.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Indexing history: what each index or detect run changed.

tools.name: get_relevant_kv
tools.description: Saved KV state of a session that matches a query.

tools.name: save_kv_state
tools.description: Save per-chunk KV state for a session.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Roll a session back to an earlier turn.

tools.name: prune_chunks
tools.description: Drop a session's least relevant chunks to fit a token budget.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: Sessions in the store, optionally for one agent.

tools.name: rebuild_symbols
tools.description: Rebuild the symbol graph from the stored chunks.

tools.name: stale_chunks
tools.description: Chunks whose dependencies changed since they were indexed.

tools.name: get_dynamic_symbols
tools.description: Registered runtime symbols, optionally for one agent.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Agents registered across worktrees, with heartbeat status.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Files other agents changed since you last checked. limit defaults to 20.

tools.name: environment_check
tools.description: Stale __pycache__, editable-install mismatches and other environment problems.

tools.name: clean_bytecache
tools.description: Remove orphaned .pyc files from stale __pycache__ directories.

tools.name: bulk_store_embeddings
tools.description: Store your own embedding vectors for chunks.

embeddings.type: object of chunk_id to number list

tools.name: bulk_store_chunk_agent_notes
tools.description: Store agent notes on chunks.

tools.name: get_chunk_history
tools.description: Version history of chunks across indexing runs.

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Run several tool calls in one request: operations [{method, params}].

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Storage statistics (1.x name; doctor covers it).

tools.name: project_brief
tools.description: Largest files and extension counts (1.x name; doctor covers it).

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Create one annotation (1.x name; annotations action=create).

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Annotations of a target (1.x name; annotations action=get).

tools.name: delete_annotation
tools.description: Delete an annotation (1.x name; annotations action=delete).

tools.name: update_annotation
tools.description: Update an annotation (1.x name; annotations action=update).

tools.name: search_annotations
tools.description: Search annotations (1.x name; annotations action=search).

tools.name: bulk_annotate
tools.description: Create many annotations (1.x name; annotations action=bulk_create).

tools.name: acquire_document_lock
tools.description: Acquire a lock (1.x name; document_lock action=acquire).

tools.name: refresh_document_lock
tools.description: Refresh a lock (1.x name; document_lock action=refresh).

tools.name: release_document_lock
tools.description: Release a lock (1.x name; document_lock action=release).

tools.name: get_document_lock_status
tools.description: Lock status (1.x name; document_lock action=status).

tools.name: release_agent_locks
tools.description: Release an agent's locks (1.x name; document_lock action=release_all).

tools.name: get_conflicts
tools.description: Lock conflicts (1.x name; document_lock action=conflicts).

tools.name: reap_expired_locks
tools.description: Reap expired locks (1.x name; document_lock action=reap).

tools.name: store_semantic_summary
tools.description: Store one chunk summary (1.x name; bulk_store_summaries).

tools.name: store_embedding
tools.description: Store one chunk vector (1.x name; bulk_store_embeddings).

tools.name: store_chunk_agent_notes
tools.description: Store notes on one chunk (1.x name; bulk_store_chunk_agent_notes).
